entries.en: The defeated chess player returned the next day seeking revenge.
entries.zh: 那位输棋的选手第二天又来了，想一雪前耻。

entries.en: These green apples are too sour for my taste.
entries.zh: 这些青苹果对我来说太酸了。

entries.en: She kept her passport in a small zipped pocket.
entries.zh: 她把护照放在一个带拉链的小口袋里。

entries.en: The librarian answered my query about the opening hours.
entries.zh: 图书管理员回答了我关于开放时间的询问。

entries.en: Fresh bread lured us into the little bakery.
entries.zh: 新鲜面包吸引我们走进了那家小面包店。

entries.en: Cheers erupted when the final runner crossed the line.
entries.zh: 最后一位跑者冲线时，欢呼声骤然响起。

entries.en: The shuttle service terminates at the north gate.
entries.zh: 班车到北门终止运行。

entries.en: I felt ashamed of blaming my sister without listening.
entries.zh: 我没听妹妹解释就责怪她，为此感到羞愧。

entries.en: A dark tower loomed above the misty harbour.
entries.zh: 一座黑色高塔隐约耸立在雾蒙蒙的港口上方。

entries.en: We stopped to admire the majesty of the mountains.
entries.zh: 我们停下来欣赏群山的雄伟壮丽。

entries.en: The story begins with a witch who cannot fly.
entries.zh: 故事从一位不会飞的女巫讲起。

entries.en: On that rainy afternoon, the empty café was our salvation.
entries.zh: 那个下雨的下午，那家空荡荡的咖啡馆成了我们的救星。

entries.en: Grandpa leaned his cane against the garden bench.
entries.zh: 爷爷把手杖靠在花园长椅上。

entries.en: The hailstorm inflicted serious damage on the greenhouse.
entries.zh: 冰雹给温室造成了严重损坏。

entries.en: A sharp rap at the door interrupted our conversation.
entries.zh: 一阵急促的敲门声打断了我们的谈话。

entries.en: The exchange students forged lasting friendships during their stay.
entries.zh: 交换生们在逗留期间建立了长久的友谊。

entries.en: Road repairs disrupted bus services throughout the morning.
entries.zh: 道路维修使整个上午的公交服务受到影响。

entries.en: This workshop makes specialized tools for repairing violins.
entries.zh: 这家工坊制作修理小提琴的专用工具。

entries.en: The wicked king in the play steals everyone's dreams.
entries.zh: 剧中邪恶的国王偷走了所有人的梦。

entries.en: We postponed the picnic until the weather improved.
entries.zh: 我们把野餐推迟到天气好转以后。

entries.en: A single spelling mistake does not warrant rewriting the whole page.
entries.zh: 一个拼写错误并不值得重写整页。

entries.en: His resentment faded after they explained the misunderstanding.
entries.zh: 他们解释了误会之后，他的怨气消了。

entries.en: A dinosaur skeleton fills the centre of the museum hall.
entries.zh: 一具恐龙骨架占据了博物馆大厅的中央。

entries.en: The children painted a welcome banner for their teacher.
entries.zh: 孩子们为老师画了一条欢迎横幅。

entries.en: An insider described how the theatre chooses its plays.
entries.zh: 一位内部人士讲述了剧院如何挑选剧目。

entries.en: A flock of geese landed beside the lake.
entries.zh: 一群鹅落在了湖边。

entries.en: The forecast painted a grim picture of the coming storm.
entries.zh: 天气预报描绘了即将到来的风暴的严峻形势。

entries.en: The village pond dried up during the long drought.
entries.zh: 漫长的干旱期间，村里的池塘干涸了。

entries.en: Every member promised to uphold the club's tradition of fair play.
entries.zh: 每位成员都承诺维护俱乐部公平竞赛的传统。

entries.meaningZh: 难以对付的；令人敬畏的
entries.en: The defending champions will be formidable opponents tonight.
entries.zh: 卫冕冠军今晚将是难以对付的对手。

entries.en: Her refusal to wear the uniform was a small act of rebellion.
entries.zh: 她拒绝穿制服，是一次小小的反抗。

entries.en: Please put the empty cans in the recycling bin.
entries.zh: 请把空罐子放进回收桶。

entries.en: Dad grinds the coffee beans just before breakfast.
entries.zh: 爸爸在早饭前才磨咖啡豆。

entries.en: A few crumbs fell between the keys of my keyboard.
entries.zh: 一些碎屑掉进了我的键盘按键之间。

entries.en: A lone cyclist waited at the red light.
entries.zh: 只有一位骑车人在红灯前等候。

entries.en: The museum insured the paintings before sending them abroad.
entries.zh: 博物馆在把画作运往国外前为它们投了保。

entries.en: She took a graphic design course at the local college.
entries.zh: 她在本地学院修了一门平面设计课。

entries.en: The reviewer noted a deficiency in the book's index.
entries.zh: 评论者指出了这本书索引中的一处不足。

entries.en: We transplanted the young tomatoes into larger pots.
entries.zh: 我们把番茄幼苗移栽到了更大的花盆里。

entries.en: The tiny town experienced explosive growth after the railway opened.
entries.zh: 铁路开通后，这个小镇经历了迅猛的发展。

entries.en: There is enough chocolate pudding for six small bowls.
entries.zh: 这些巧克力布丁足够装六小碗。

entries.en: A retired congressman spoke about his years in public service.
entries.zh: 一位退休的美国国会议员讲述了自己从事公共服务的岁月。

entries.en: We grilled corn outside while the children set the table.
entries.zh: 孩子们摆餐桌时，我们在外面烤玉米。

entries.en: The picture captures the innocence of a child's curiosity.
entries.zh: 这幅画捕捉到了孩子好奇心中的纯真。

entries.en: The little pony followed its mother across the field.
entries.zh: 那匹小矮马跟着妈妈穿过田野。

entries.en: Her steady optimism helped us finish the difficult project.
entries.zh: 她始终乐观，帮助我们完成了这个困难的项目。

entries.en: We grow herbs in pots on the balcony.
entries.zh: 我们在阳台的花盆里种香草。

entries.en: The portrait shows the dancer's graceful posture.
entries.zh: 这幅肖像展现了舞者优美的姿态。

entries.en: I took a stab at solving the last crossword clue.
entries.zh: 我试着解答了填字游戏的最后一条提示。

entries.en: She flicked a speck of dust off her sleeve.
entries.zh: 她轻轻弹掉袖子上的一粒灰尘。

entries.en: Our final rehearsal ended with a perfect performance of the song.
entries.zh: 我们最后一次排练以完美演唱那首歌结束。

entries.en: Neighbours brought food in solidarity with the flooded families.
entries.zh: 邻居们送来食物，声援受洪灾的家庭。

entries.en: Discard any puzzle pieces that belong to the other set.
entries.zh: 把属于另一套拼图的拼块剔除出去。

entries.en: He flushed when everyone praised his painting.
entries.zh: 大家夸他的画时，他脸红了。

entries.en: The walking trail circles a reservoir above the town.
entries.zh: 步道环绕着镇子上方的一座水库。

entries.en: My winter coats hang at the back of the wardrobe.
entries.zh: 我的冬季外套挂在衣柜深处。

entries.en: The boat's wooden hull needed a fresh coat of paint.
entries.zh: 这条船的木质船体需要重新刷漆。

entries.en: The restored theatre sparked a renaissance in local drama.
entries.zh: 修复后的剧院带动了当地戏剧的复兴。

entries.en: A squeeze of lime brightened the flavour of the soup.
entries.zh: 挤入一点青柠汁，汤的味道更清新了。

entries.en: The car park attendant pointed us towards an empty space.
entries.zh: 停车场工作人员指给我们一个空车位。

entries.en: One ripe strawberry was hidden beneath the leaves.
entries.zh: 一颗熟草莓藏在叶子下面。

entries.en: The teacher used coloured balls to explain atomic structure.
entries.zh: 老师用彩色小球解释原子结构。

entries.en: This portable speaker fits easily in my backpack.
entries.zh: 这个便携音箱很容易装进我的背包。

entries.en: My magazine subscription includes access to the online archive.
entries.zh: 我订阅杂志后也能访问它的在线档案。

entries.en: The towel absorbed the moisture from the wet window.
entries.zh: 毛巾吸干了湿窗上的水分。

entries.en: It was ironic that the umbrella shop closed because of rain.
entries.zh: 雨伞店竟因下雨而关门，真有讽刺意味。

entries.en: The building superintendent came to inspect the broken lift.
entries.zh: 大楼管理员来检查坏掉的电梯。

entries.en: The loose window rattled whenever a truck passed.
entries.zh: 每当卡车驶过，那扇松动的窗户就咔嗒作响。

entries.en: I left a bowl of cherries in the fridge.
entries.zh: 我在冰箱里放了一碗樱桃。

entries.en: The dog sniffed every bag we brought home.
entries.zh: 我们带回家的每个袋子，狗都闻了一遍。

entries.en: The sudden ring of the doorbell startled the sleeping cat.
entries.zh: 门铃突然响起，把睡着的猫吓了一跳。

entries.en: The garden looks gorgeous when the roses are open.
entries.zh: 玫瑰盛开时，花园美极了。

entries.en: My cousins tease me about my enormous collection of mugs.
entries.zh: 表兄妹们拿我收藏的大量杯子打趣。

entries.en: The waiter brought an extra chair for our guest.
entries.zh: 服务员为我们的客人又搬来一把椅子。

entries.en: After losing his keys twice, he vowed to be more careful.
entries.zh: 丢了两次钥匙后，他发誓要更加小心。

entries.en: The candidate spent weeks listening to the concerns of the electorate.
entries.zh: 这位候选人花了数周倾听选民们关心的问题。

entries.en: We spread homemade plum jam on warm toast.
entries.zh: 我们把自制李子酱涂在热吐司上。

entries.en: A handful of marbles tumbled out of the box.
entries.zh: 一把弹珠从盒子里滚了出来。

entries.en: In the fairy tale, a royal decree bans all music.
entries.zh: 童话中，一道王室法令禁止了所有音乐。

entries.en: A single spotlight lit the singer at centre stage.
entries.zh: 一束聚光灯照着舞台中央的歌手。

entries.en: The museum displays letters written by early settlers.
entries.zh: 博物馆展出了早期定居者写的信。

entries.en: The photographer's name appears beside the copyright notice.
entries.zh: 摄影师的名字出现在版权声明旁边。

entries.en: She scraped the dried mud off her boots.
entries.zh: 她刮掉了靴子上的干泥。

entries.en: The team tested an autonomous robot in an empty classroom.
entries.zh: 团队在一间空教室里测试了一台自主机器人。

entries.en: I bumped my elbow against the edge of the desk.
entries.zh: 我的胳膊肘撞到了桌沿。

entries.en: The team's aggregate was twelve points after three rounds.
entries.zh: 三轮过后，这支队伍的总分是十二分。

entries.en: I lowered the blind to reduce the afternoon glare.
entries.zh: 我放下百叶窗，减弱午后刺眼的阳光。

entries.en: The library announced an amnesty for overdue books.
entries.zh: 图书馆宣布免除逾期还书的处罚。

entries.en: She found her old visa inside a travel journal.
entries.zh: 她在一本旅行日记里找到了旧签证。

entries.meaningZh: 丝毫；任何（用于强调否定）
entries.en: The old radio made no sound whatsoever.
entries.zh: 那台旧收音机一点声音也没有。

entries.en: By coincidence, we booked seats on the same train.
entries.zh: 碰巧，我们订了同一班火车的座位。

entries.en: The whole family gathered on the eve of the wedding.
entries.zh: 婚礼前夜，全家人聚在了一起。

entries.en: A white goose guarded the gate with loud honks.
entries.zh: 一只白鹅大声叫着守在门口。

entries.en: The peach was so juicy that I needed a napkin.
entries.zh: 那个桃子汁水太多，我得用纸巾擦一擦。

entries.en: Her teacher nurtured her interest in drawing maps.
entries.zh: 老师培养了她画地图的兴趣。

entries.en: Be careful not to tread on the young plants.
entries.zh: 小心别踩到幼苗。

entries.en: I wrote the address on a scrap of paper.
entries.zh: 我把地址写在了一小片纸上。

entries.en: She gave us a vivid account of the boat race.
entries.zh: 她生动地向我们讲述了那场赛艇比赛。

entries.en: The caretaker responded promptly when we reported the leak.
entries.zh: 我们报告漏水情况后，管理员立即作出了回应。

entries.en: The mystery novel revolves around a missing bottle of poison.
entries.zh: 这部推理小说围绕一瓶失踪的毒药展开。

entries.en: On Sundays, I indulge in a long breakfast and a newspaper.
entries.zh: 周日，我会悠闲地吃早饭、看报纸，享受一番。

entries.en: His pirate disguise included a hat and a cardboard sword.
entries.zh: 他的海盗装扮包括一顶帽子和一把纸板剑。

entries.en: These flowers flourish in the sunny corner of our garden.
entries.zh: 这些花在我们花园向阳的角落长得很茂盛。

entries.en: We shared an umbrella on the walk to the station.
entries.zh: 去车站的路上，我们共撑一把伞。

entries.en: A small drawer is hidden underneath the seat.
entries.zh: 座位下面藏着一个小抽屉。

entries.en: The first batch of biscuits came out slightly burnt.
entries.zh: 第一炉饼干出炉时有点烤焦了。

entries.en: A tiny spider spun a web across the flowerpot.
entries.zh: 一只小蜘蛛在花盆上结了一张网。

entries.en: His obsession with old maps fills an entire bookshelf.
entries.zh: 他痴迷于旧地图，收藏装满了整整一架书。

entries.en: The dancers ended the show with a vigorous routine.
entries.zh: 舞者们以一段充满活力的舞蹈结束了演出。

entries.en: The school invited a speaker to discuss food and nutrition.
entries.zh: 学校请来一位嘉宾讨论食物与营养。

entries.en: Thick stone pillars support the roof of the old hall.
entries.zh: 粗大的石柱支撑着旧大厅的屋顶。

entries.en: He collects recordings by obscure bands from the seventies.
entries.zh: 他收藏七十年代鲜为人知的乐队的唱片。

entries.en: I recognized the melody but could not remember the song's name.
entries.zh: 我认出了旋律，却想不起歌名。

entries.en: We could barely restrain our laughter during his silly story.
entries.zh: 他讲那个滑稽故事时，我们差点忍不住笑出来。

entries.en: With its quiet coves, the island is a paradise for kayakers.
entries.zh: 岛上有宁静的海湾，是皮划艇爱好者的乐园。

entries.en: The eventual winner started the race in last place.
entries.zh: 最终的冠军在比赛开始时排在最后。

entries.en: A physicist visited our class to demonstrate how magnets work.
entries.zh: 一位物理学家来到我们班，演示磁铁的工作原理。

entries.en: The salesman showed us how to fold the camping table.
entries.zh: 售货员向我们演示了如何折叠露营桌。

entries.en: The family cultivates vegetables on a narrow strip of land.
entries.zh: 这家人在一条狭长的地块上种菜。

entries.en: Waiting for the competition results was pure agony.
entries.zh: 等待比赛结果完全是一种煎熬。

entries.en: The new drummer injected energy into the tired band's performance.
entries.zh: 新鼓手给这支疲惫乐队的演出注入了活力。

entries.en: Please move the microphone closer to the speaker.
entries.zh: 请把麦克风移得离发言者近一些。

entries.en: Goodbye, everyone; I hope we meet again soon.
entries.zh: 大家再见，希望我们很快再见面。

entries.en: The lightweight frame is made of aluminium.
entries.zh: 这个轻巧的框架是铝制的。

entries.en: A bright red cherry sat on top of each cake.
entries.zh: 每块蛋糕上都放着一颗鲜红的樱桃。

entries.en: The heroine defies the king's order and leaves the castle.
entries.zh: 女主角违抗国王的命令，离开了城堡。

entries.en: She was unwilling to lend out her favourite camera.
entries.zh: 她不愿意把最心爱的相机借出去。

entries.en: The lanterns gave the snowy garden a magical glow.
entries.zh: 灯笼让雪中的花园泛起迷人的光。

entries.en: The lamp's plug had fallen behind the cabinet.
entries.zh: 台灯的插头掉到了柜子后面。

entries.en: We struggled to reconcile the two different accounts of the event.
entries.zh: 我们努力调和对这件事的两种不同说法。

entries.en: The silence in the empty house made me uneasy.
entries.zh: 空房子里的寂静让我感到不安。

entries.en: A heap of autumn leaves blocked the garden gate.
entries.zh: 一堆秋叶挡住了花园门。

entries.en: He carried a bundle of blankets up the stairs.
entries.zh: 他抱着一捆毯子上了楼。

entries.en: Warm applause greeted the youngest performer of the evening.
entries.zh: 当晚最年轻的表演者迎来了热烈掌声。

entries.en: Our spontaneous trip to the coast became a favourite memory.
entries.zh: 我们那次说走就走的海边旅行成了美好的回忆。

entries.en: My suitcase has a yellow ribbon tied to its handle.
entries.zh: 我的行李箱把手上系着一条黄丝带。

entries.en: The normally busy market was unusually quiet this morning.
entries.zh: 平时繁忙的市场今早格外安静。

entries.en: The lecture introduced the idea of a quantum of light.
entries.zh: 这场讲座介绍了光量子的概念。

entries.en: We found a shady spot for our picnic.
entries.zh: 我们找了个阴凉处野餐。

entries.en: A mighty oak stood in the middle of the field.
entries.zh: 一棵巨大的橡树立在田野中央。

entries.en: The poem speaks of eternal love and distant stars.
entries.zh: 这首诗写到了永恒的爱情和遥远的星辰。

entries.en: Our neighbours prepared a feast to celebrate the harvest.
entries.zh: 邻居们准备了一顿盛宴庆祝丰收。

entries.en: The film is an indictment of wasteful consumer habits.
entries.zh: 这部电影是对浪费型消费习惯的控诉。

entries.en: Pour the mixture into the mould and leave it to set.
entries.zh: 把混合物倒进模具，放置至凝固。

entries.en: The shop keeps dairy products in a separate chilled cabinet.
entries.zh: 商店把乳制品放在单独的冷藏柜里。

entries.en: A surprise visit from former players lifted the team's morale.
entries.zh: 老队员们的意外到访鼓舞了球队的士气。

entries.en: The model cars stopped just before a collision.
entries.zh: 两辆模型车在即将相撞时停住了。

entries.en: We dashed across the courtyard as the rain began.
entries.zh: 刚下雨时，我们飞奔着穿过庭院。

entries.en: It was rude to interrupt her story like that.
entries.zh: 那样打断她讲故事很不礼貌。

entries.en: The whole clan gathered for our grandmother's eightieth birthday.
entries.zh: 全家族聚在一起为祖母庆祝八十岁生日。

entries.en: It took some diplomacy to choose a restaurant everyone liked.
entries.zh: 要选出一家人人都喜欢的餐厅，还真得讲究些交际手腕。

entries.en: The recipe calls for a spice I have never used.
entries.zh: 食谱要用一种我从未用过的香料。

entries.en: She dressed as a fairy for the school play.
entries.zh: 她在校园剧中装扮成了一位仙子。

entries.en: The little bird hopped from one branch to another.
entries.zh: 那只小鸟从一根树枝跳到另一根上。

entries.en: Our first attempt to build a kite was unsuccessful.
entries.zh: 我们第一次做风筝的尝试没有成功。

entries.en: The children offered imaginative explanations for the strange footprints.
entries.zh: 孩子们对那些奇怪脚印提出了富有想象力的解释。

entries.en: Volunteers cleared fallen branches in the aftermath of the storm.
entries.zh: 风暴过后，志愿者清理了掉落的树枝。

entries.en: Winning the award brought the small theatre considerable prestige.
entries.zh: 获奖给这家小剧院带来了很高的声望。

entries.en: He cut the sausage into small pieces for the stew.
entries.zh: 他把香肠切成小块用来炖菜。

entries.en: The novel follows a young lieutenant on his first assignment.
entries.zh: 小说讲述了一位年轻陆军中尉第一次执行任务的经历。

entries.en: The registration form asks for your name and nationality.
entries.zh: 登记表要求填写姓名和国籍。

entries.en: Leaving a reading lamp for our guest was thoughtful.
entries.zh: 为客人留一盏阅读灯很体贴。

entries.en: A flowering vine climbed around the porch window.
entries.zh: 一株开花的藤蔓绕着门廊窗户攀爬。

entries.en: The suggestion that our cat could open the safe was absurd.
entries.zh: 说我们家的猫能打开保险箱，实在荒谬。

entries.en: She chose light linen for the summer curtains.
entries.zh: 她选了轻薄的亚麻布做夏季窗帘。

entries.en: A nun showed visitors around the old convent garden.
entries.zh: 一位修女带游客参观了古老修道院的花园。

entries.en: I was a little jealous of her beautiful new bicycle.
entries.zh: 我有点羡慕她那辆漂亮的新自行车。

entries.en: The quiet courtyard became a haven from the noisy streets.
entries.zh: 安静的庭院成了远离喧闹街道的安宁之所。

entries.en: A rainbow appeared above the hills after the shower.
entries.zh: 阵雨过后，山丘上方出现了一道彩虹。

entries.en: The lovely view offsets the room's rather small size.
entries.zh: 优美的景色弥补了房间偏小的不足。

entries.en: The green cushions complement the wooden furniture beautifully.
entries.zh: 绿色靠垫与木家具搭配得很漂亮。

entries.en: The train stopped with a sudden jerk.
entries.zh: 火车猛地一晃停了下来。

entries.en: The vicar welcomed visitors to the village church.
entries.zh: 教区牧师欢迎来访者来到村里的教堂。

entries.en: A noisy mob surrounded the bus carrying the winning team.
entries.zh: 一群喧闹的人围住了载着获胜球队的巴士。

entries.en: The centre offers swimming and other forms of recreation.
entries.zh: 该中心提供游泳和其他休闲活动。

entries.en: The fragile vase arrived in layers of protective packaging.
entries.zh: 这只易碎花瓶裹着多层保护包装送到了。

entries.en: The coach affirmed her confidence in the new players.
entries.zh: 教练明确表示了对新队员的信心。

entries.en: We sipped hot tea while waiting for the rain to stop.
entries.zh: 我们一边小口喝热茶，一边等雨停。

entries.en: The photographs cover a span of fifty years.
entries.zh: 这些照片跨越了五十年的时光。

entries.en: A few guests lingered by the door after the party.
entries.zh: 聚会结束后，几位客人还在门口逗留。

entries.en: Everyone applauded as the nervous young pianist stood up.
entries.zh: 那位紧张的年轻钢琴家起身时，大家都鼓掌了。

entries.en: A faint light shone through the gloom of the cellar.
entries.zh: 一缕微光穿过昏暗的地窖。

entries.en: We added a wooden brace to stabilize the wobbly shelf.
entries.zh: 我们加了一根木撑条来固定摇晃的架子。

entries.en: Drop one sugar cube into each cup.
entries.zh: 每个杯子里放一块方糖。

entries.en: This glass jug holds exactly one litre of water.
entries.zh: 这个玻璃壶恰好能装一升水。

entries.en: The local craft guild organizes a fair every spring.
entries.zh: 当地手工艺协会每年春天举办一次集市。

entries.en: We could barely read the menu in the dim light.
entries.zh: 灯光昏暗，我们几乎看不清菜单。

entries.en: Her facial expression told us she had understood the joke.
entries.zh: 她的面部表情告诉我们，她听懂了那个笑话。

entries.en: The bus passed a tea plantation on the hillside.
entries.zh: 巴士经过了山坡上的一处茶园。

entries.en: The film was enjoyable despite its predictable ending.
entries.zh: 尽管结局可以预料，这部电影还是很好看。

entries.en: We reached the hilltop just in time for sunset.
entries.zh: 我们到达山顶时，正赶上日落。

entries.en: The portrait shows the monarch wearing a heavy crown.
entries.zh: 这幅肖像中的君主戴着一顶沉重的王冠。

entries.en: The weekly bulletin lists upcoming events at the centre.
entries.zh: 每周简报列出了中心即将举行的活动。

entries.en: We learned to skate at the indoor rink last winter.
entries.zh: 去年冬天，我们在室内冰场学会了滑冰。

entries.en: You did a fabulous job decorating the little hall.
entries.zh: 你把这个小大厅装饰得棒极了。

entries.en: The legend says a curse protects the hidden treasure.
entries.zh: 传说有一道诅咒守护着隐藏的宝藏。

entries.en: The railway carries freight through the valley at night.
entries.zh: 这条铁路夜间运送货物穿过山谷。

entries.en: The memoir describes the family's search for asylum abroad.
entries.zh: 这本回忆录描述了这个家庭在国外寻求庇护的经历。

entries.en: Steam rose from the mug beside her notebook.
entries.zh: 她笔记本旁的大杯里冒着热气。

entries.en: The school disco ended with everyone's favourite song.
entries.zh: 学校的迪斯科舞会以大家最喜欢的歌曲结束。
